page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs, which correspond to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading, and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes a bundled 1919 GB local SSD storage volume and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance split between single-core and multi-core workloads. Single-core CPU performance is weak, ranking in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests, with single-threaded gzip and bzip3 compression falling into the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance is average, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the overall PassMark memory score is weak.

The server offers a high-capacity local SSD storage resource, making it suitable for storage-intensive and database workloads that benefit from localized disk access. However, the weak single-threaded performance and lower memory score present a tradeoff for compute-heavy or highly sequential processing tasks. It is best suited for relational databases, distributed file systems, static web serving, and multi-threaded applications that can leverage the 16 dedicated vCPUs and local storage without requiring high single-core clock speeds.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.4xlarge is an x86_64 server featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor, 64.0 GB of memory, and a bundled 1919 GB local SSD. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. Benchmark results show weak single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores in the bottom 25%, and poor single-threaded compression speeds. However, its multi-core capabilities, memory bandwidth, and static web serving throughput perform in the average tier. The combination of dedicated vCPUs and high-capacity local SSD storage makes this instance a viable option for database operations, web serving, and multi-threaded workloads where local storage density is prioritized over high single-threaded compute performance.
